order: Score a blind validation pass against the pre-registered follow-on corpus and record every disagreement in a ledger. Complete and save the independent pass before the sealed corpus file is opened, then compare it item by item against the reference scoring and report the match rate against the pre-registered threshold. For each disagreement, name the two candidate classes and state whether it reflects a genuine ambiguity in the boundary rule or a flaw found in the corpus item itself; do not silently drop or reclassify a disagreement. If the match rate falls short of the threshold, trigger the pre-registered next step — a further boundary redraw — before the taxonomy is treated as validated for encoding downstream.
claims: The independent pass scored 17 of 20 (85 percent) against the pre-registered corpus, missing the threshold. Three disagreements were logged in the ledger — one on an evidence-class pair, one flagged as a genuine ambiguity at the ambiguity cap, and one on a diagnosis-class pair — with no flaw found in any corpus item itself. Per the pre-registered rule, a second boundary redraw was triggered before the taxonomy proceeds to downstream encoding.
